insight: Formed in 2024 from Yandex N.V.'s non-Russian assets after Yandex's Russia exit; resumed Nasdaq trading as NBIS that October.
name: Nebius
tagline: Full-stack AI cloud for training and inference at scale.
description: AI-native cloud built around large NVIDIA GPU clusters — bare-metal and virtualized H100 through Blackwell hardware with InfiniBand networking, managed Slurm and Kubernetes, high-speed storage, and MLOps tooling. Its Token Factory layer adds managed per-token inference for open-weight models. Microsoft signed a five-year capacity deal with Nebius worth up to $19.4B.

modelSupport.notes: Raw GPU infrastructure runs anything you bring; Token Factory serves open-weight models per token.

edge: Covers the full AI stack — bare-metal GPU clusters, managed Slurm/Kubernetes, and per-token Token Factory inference — where many GPU clouds stop at compute.
pros: Latest NVIDIA silicon, H100 through Blackwell
Managed Slurm and Kubernetes built in
Nasdaq-listed, with Microsoft and Meta deals
cons: Younger ecosystem than the big general clouds

references.title: Why Microsoft's AI infrastructure deal with Nebius is savvy
